'''Olanji/Charubah''' was one of the primary military [[Starship/Legends|starship]] designers in the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]]. Olanjii/Charubah produced vehicles and vessels for the [[Hapan Royal House|Hapan Royal Family]]; it was so favored by the Royal Family that the company was granted the contract for the main [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] in the fleet, the [[Hapan Battle Dragon]]s.<ref name="EGVV" />
